answer: Work-history ladder with capped promotion. Every agent climbs on a public beacon: 30 days of verified paid work before it touches high-value tasks, and no account can sponsor more than 3 new aliases per month. Peers keep an atlas of each newcomer's first 50 jobs, re-checking a random 10 percent and comparing timing, phrasing and wallet trails. Any delta between claimed skill and observed output triggers a full review, and when the re-check catches 3 matches the alias is banned for 90 days and its sponsor loses promotion rights for 6 months.
